日文.首段:
長野電鉄1000系電車（ながのでんてつ1000けいでんしゃ）は、長野電鉄の特急形電車。
「ゆけむり」の愛称を持つ。

章节.概要:
老朽化した2000系車両の代替として、小田急電鉄で使用されていたロマンスカーの10000形「HiSE」を無償で譲り受けた車両である。車齢としては引退当時18年とまだ若かったが、ハイデッカー構造であるため小田急電鉄ではバリアフリーに対応できないとし運用離脱、廃車となった車両である。

本形式の導入により2000系は基本的にA特急運用から撤退することになった。
章节.車体:
車体は小田急時代の塗り分けを踏襲するが、計画の変更により、小田急時代に2色のワインレッド■■に塗り分けられていた部分は長野電鉄の長電レッド■に変更・統一されている。
小田急時代に6号車に設置されていた冷房装置などのサービス機器に電力を供給する補助電源装置は2号車に設置された。これ以外にも、長野電鉄仕様として信州中野駅 - 湯田中駅間の連続40‰の急勾配に対応するための抑速ブレーキの改造（主抵抗器の増強）、降雪期に備えて耐雪ブレーキやドアレールヒーターの装備などが施工されているが、外観においては編成の短縮以外に小田急時代と大きく変わるところはない。
章节.車内:
全車禁煙。外観同様、車内設備もおおむね小田急時代を保っている。

1号車および4号車先頭部には展望席が小田急時代と変更なく存置されているが、この部分はハイデッカー構造ではないため、ここをバリアフリー対応とすることで小田急時代より懸念されていた問題に対処した。ただし、この処置により展望室と一般客室の境にあった補助椅子は使用不可となっている。なお、乗車口のドア幅は最低62 cmとやや狭く、乗車時にスロープを使用できないため、車椅子によっては利用できない場合がある。
その他設備のうち、トイレと洗面所は車両基地に対応設備が無く、これらを設けた中間車を譲渡対象から外しているため、設置されていない。
2015年9月ごろに自動放送設備が導入され、山崎昭夫が担当している。
自動放送導入と同時に、新たに2か国語（日/英）停車駅や列車情報などをスクロール表示するLED車内案内表示装置を新設した。
展望席を含む先頭車は、日中に運行されるA特急運用時のみ指定席となる。背面展望席・普通席はA特急・B特急問わず自由席である。
小田急時代に受賞した鉄道友の会ブルーリボン賞の受賞記念プレートは存置されている（掲出場所は一部でLED案内表示器の設置により移動が行われている）。
号車番号／設備他

先頭車：運転室（2階）・展望席（14席）・普通席（32席）・車掌室
中間車：普通席（44席）
章节.編成表:
4車体5台車の連接構造で、小田急時代は11車体12台車であったものから一部の中間車を抜き短編成化した。なお4両化時に余った中間車（7両×2）については、譲渡されずに小田急側で解体処分された。
編成は以下の通り。

長野電鉄では、8500系導入以降電動制御車を「デハ」、中間電動車を「モハ」と呼称している（形式称号改正による）。
（ ）内は小田急時代の車両番号
中央の1台車が付随台車のため、台車数でみたMT比は4：1となる
編成全長は57,780mmでボギー車のほぼ3両分
章节.運用:
運行開始当初はA特急で限定運用され、B特急では引き続き2000系を運用していた。
しかし、2011年2月13日に2100系の運用開始を踏まえて実施されたダイヤ改正からA・Bともに運用されるように変更された。同時に運用間合いでの普通列車への充当も廃止された。この結果、本形式としては従前同様に長野線全線のA特急に用いられるほか、B特急にも充当されることとなり、運用時間帯が拡大している。
なお、2015年から運行している「のんびり号」では本形式が限定運用されているほか、「北信濃ワインバレー列車」「ながでん BEER TRAIN」等の臨時列車でも優先して使用される。また2012年の屋代線廃止時には、車両輸送時以来となる同線での走行が実施された。
章节.沿革:
2005年
8月12日 - 小田急電鉄から10000形全4編成のうち2編成が長野電鉄に対して無償譲渡される。
12月15日 - 2006年1月31日 - 車両愛称の募集が行われる。総数2,992通の応募があった。
2006年
3月17日 - 車両愛称が「ゆけむり」と決定。
11月3日・4日 - 試乗・内覧会を実施。長野駅 - 湯田中駅間にて試乗列車が運転された。
12月2日 - 長電観光主催「ゆけむり貸切特別ツアー」が実施された。
12月9日 - ダイヤ改正に合わせて営業運転を開始。
2007年
1月10日 - 2月1日 - 第2編成（S2編成）1号車の展望席部分の窓ガラスにヒビが入っているのが確認されたため、同編成使用列車は1号車を締切にし、残り3両の客扱いで営業運転を行った。修理は1月30日 - 2月1日に行い、代走として2000系が使用された。
7月9日 - 30日 - 第2編成（S2編成）4号車の展望席部分の窓ガラスにヒビが入っているのが確認されたため、運用を離脱、2000系が代走した。
2010年
1月12日 - 25日 - 小田急7000形と種車の10000形で車両の連結部分の金属に複数の傷が見つかり、その影響で1000系についても臨時に検査するため、運用を離脱。
2011年
2月13日 - ダイヤ改正によりB特急への充当を開始。
9月 - 自動放送、LED車内案内表示装置を導入。
2015年
4月18日 - 観光案内列車「ゆけむり〜のんびり号〜」の運転を開始。検査時等を除き、本形式が限定運用される。
章节.その他:
第1・2編成とも日本車輌製造豊川製作所で改造されたが、いずれの編成も川崎重工業で製造されたものであった。なお、小田急10000形には日本車輌製造製の編成もあり、ロマンスカーミュージアムで保存されているデハ10001がそのうちの1両である。
本形式の導入に関連して、湯田中駅では2006年9月に構内スイッチバックとプラットホーム1線を廃止し、1面1線化するなどの縮小工事を行った。
2011年2月13日のダイヤ改正まで、信州中野駅 - 湯田中駅間を各駅に停まる特急列車（B特急）には充当されなかった。また、須坂駅で2000系から車両交換をする運用もあり、この場合、時刻表で指定された列車に乗り継げば、1枚の特急券で利用することが可能であった。
本形式が導入された後も、特急料金は100円のまま据え置かれた。ただし、2000系とは異なり運用される列車が全て特急運用となったため、運用開始以来、乗車には特急料金が必要とされている。
2021年6月1日より、日中に運行するA特急の先頭車両（展望席を含む）を、指定席としてWEBページから予約が出来るようになった。（各種イベントや団体利用、その他ダイヤ乱れ時を除く）

中文.首段:
长野电铁1000系电车（ながのでんてつ1000けいでんしゃ）是长野电铁的特急型电车。
拥有“汤烟（ゆけむり）”的爱称。

章节.概要:
作为老化2000系车辆的替代，无偿受让了小田急电铁使用的浪漫特快10000型“HiSE”的车辆。从车龄来看引退当时为18年，尚属年轻，但由于是高驾驶室（HiDeck）结构，小田急电铁认为无法对应无障碍化而运用离脱、报废的车辆。
随着本型的引进，2000系基本退出了A特急运用。
章节.車体:
车体沿袭小田急时代的涂装划分，但由于计划变更，小田急时代涂分为2色酒红色■■的部分改为长野电铁的长电红■并统一。
小田急时代设置在6号车、为冷房装置等服务设备供电的辅助电源装置改设于2号车。除此之外，作为长野电铁规格，还实施了为应对信州中野站 - 汤田中站间连续40‰急陡坡的抑速制动改造（主电阻器增强）、为备降雪期而装备耐雪制动和门轨加热器等，但外观上除编组缩短以外与小田急时代没有大的不同。
章节.車内:
全车禁烟。与外观一样，车内设备也大体保持小田急时代的状态。
1号车及4号车头部设有与小田急时代无异的展望席，但该部分并非高驾驶室结构，因此通过将此部分对应无障碍化，处理了小田急时代以来令人担忧的问题。不过，由于这一处理，位于展望室与一般客室交界处的辅助座椅变得无法使用。另外，上车口的车门宽度最低62 cm，略窄，乘车时无法使用坡道，因此部分轮椅可能无法使用。
其他设备中，厕所和洗手间因车辆基地没有对应设备，而设有这些设备的中间车被排除在让渡对象之外，因此未设置。
2015年9月左右引进了自动广播设备，由山崎昭夫担任。
在引进自动广播的同时，新设了以2种语言（日/英）滚动显示停车站和列车信息等的LED车内向导显示装置。
包括展望席在内的先头车，仅在白天运行的A特急运用时为指定席。背面展望席・普通席无论A特急、B特急均为自由席。
小田急时代获得的铁道友之会蓝丝带奖的获奖纪念牌被保留（揭出场所部分因设置LED向导显示器而有所移动）。

== 概要 ==
作为老化2000系车辆的替代，无偿受让了小田急电铁使用的浪漫特快10000型“HiSE”的车辆。从车龄来看引退当时为18年，尚属年轻，但由于是高驾驶室（HiDeck）结构，小田急电铁认为无法对应无障碍化而运用离脱、报废的车辆。

全车禁烟。与外观一样，车内设备也大体保持小田急时代的状态。

其他设备中，厕所和洗手间因车辆基地没有对应设备，而设有这些设备的中间车被排除在让渡对象之外，因此未设置。
2015年9月左右引进了自动广播设备，由山崎昭夫担任。
在引进自动广播的同时，新设了以2种语言（日/英）滚动显示停车站和列车信息等的LED车内向导显示装置。
包括展望席在内的先头车，仅在白天运行的A特急运用时为指定席。背面展望席・普通席无论A特急、B特急均为自由席。

中间车：普通席（44席）

英文.词条标题: Nagano Electric Railway 1000 series electric car
英文.首段:
The Nagano Electric Railway 1000 series electric car (Nagano Dentetsu 1000-kei densha) is a limited express electric car of the Nagano Electric Railway.
It bears the nickname "Yukemuri."

章节.概要:
As a replacement for the aging 2000 series cars, this is a vehicle acquired free of charge from the Odakyu Electric Railway, where it had been used as the Romancecar 10000 type "HiSE." In terms of age it was still young at 18 years when retired, but because it had a high-deck structure, Odakyu Electric Railway judged that it could not be made barrier-free, and it was withdrawn from service and scrapped.
With the introduction of this type, the 2000 series basically withdrew from A limited express operations.
章节.車体:
The body follows the two-tone scheme of the Odakyu era, but due to a change in plans, the part that was painted in two shades of wine red in the Odakyu era was changed to and unified as the Nagano Electric Railway's Nagaden Red.
The auxiliary power supply that had been installed in car No. 6 in the Odakyu era to supply power to service equipment such as the air-conditioning units was installed in car No. 2. In addition, as Nagano Electric Railway specifications, modifications were carried out such as modifying the speed-limiting brake (reinforcing the main resistors) to cope with the continuous 40‰ steep gradient between Shinshū-Nakano Station and Yudanaka Station, and fitting snow-resistant brakes and door-rail heaters in preparation for the snowfall season, but apart from the shortening of the formation, there is no major external difference from the Odakyu era.
章节.車内:
All cars are non-smoking. As with the exterior, the interior equipment largely retains the state of the Odakyu era.
Observation seats are retained unchanged from the Odakyu era at the front of cars No. 1 and No. 4, but since this part is not of high-deck structure, the problem that had been a concern since the Odakyu era was addressed by making this part barrier-free. However, because of this measure, the auxiliary seats at the boundary between the observation room and the general passenger cabin have become unusable. Also, the boarding door width is a somewhat narrow minimum of 62 cm, and since a ramp cannot be used when boarding, some wheelchairs may be unable to use it.
Among the other facilities, toilets and washrooms are not provided, because the depot has no corresponding facilities and the intermediate cars that had them were excluded from the transfer.
Around September 2015 automatic announcement equipment was introduced, handled by Yamazaki Akio.
At the same time as the introduction of automatic announcements, LED in-car information displays that scroll through stopping stations and train information in two languages (Japanese/English) were newly installed.
The end cars, including the observation seats, are reserved seats only during A limited express operations that run in the daytime. The rear-facing observation seats and ordinary seats are non-reserved regardless of A or B limited express.
The commemorative plaques for the Blue Ribbon Award received from the Japan Railfan Club in the Odakyu era are retained (their display locations have been moved in some cases due to the installation of LED information displays).
Car number / facilities etc.

End car: cab (2nd floor), observation seats (14 seats), ordinary seats (32 seats), conductor's room
Intermediate car: ordinary seats (44 seats)
章节.編成表:
It has an articulated structure of 4 car bodies and 5 bogies, shortened from the 11 car bodies and 12 bogies of the Odakyu era by removing some intermediate cars. The intermediate cars left over when the formation was reduced to four cars (7 cars x 2) were not transferred and were dismantled on the Odakyu side.
The formations are as follows.

Since the introduction of the 8500 series, Nagano Electric Railway calls control motor cars "DeHa" and intermediate motor cars "MoHa" (due to a revision of type designations).
The numbers in parentheses are the car numbers of the Odakyu era.
Because the central single bogie is a trailer bogie, the MT ratio counted by number of bogies is 4:1.
The total formation length is 57,780 mm, roughly equivalent to nearly three bogie cars.
章节.運用:
At the start of operation it was used exclusively for A limited express services, and the 2000 series continued to be used for B limited express services.
However, from the timetable revision carried out on February 13, 2011 in conjunction with the start of operation of the 2100 series, it was changed to be used for both A and B services. At the same time, its use for ordinary trains between duties was abolished. As a result, this type came to be used, as before, for A limited express services on the entire Nagano Line and also for B limited express services, expanding its operating time bands.
In addition, on the "Nonbiri-gō" operated since 2015 this type is used exclusively, and it is also given priority on special trains such as the "Kitashinano Wine Valley Train" and the "Nagaden BEER TRAIN." Furthermore, when the Yashiro Line was abolished in 2012, it was run on that line for the first time since the vehicle transport.
章节.沿革:
2005
August 12 - Of the four 10000-type formations of Odakyu Electric Railway, two formations are transferred free of charge to Nagano Electric Railway.
December 15 - January 31, 2006 - A competition is held to solicit a car nickname. A total of 2,992 entries were received.
2006
March 17 - The car nickname is decided as "Yukemuri."
November 3 and 4 - Trial rides and an open-house event are held. A trial-ride train was operated between Nagano Station and Yudanaka Station.
December 2 - The "Yukemuri Charter Special Tour" organized by Nagaden Kankō is held.
December 9 - Revenue service begins in conjunction with the timetable revision.
2007
January 10 - February 1 - Because cracks were found in the window glass of the observation-seat part of car No. 1 of the 2nd formation (S2 formation), trains using that formation were operated with car No. 1 closed off and the remaining three cars carrying passengers. Repairs were carried out from January 30 to February 1, and a 2000 series ran as a substitute.
July 9 - 30 - Because cracks were found in the window glass of the observation-seat part of car No. 4 of the 2nd formation (S2 formation), it was withdrawn from service and a 2000 series ran as a substitute.
2010
January 12 - 25 - Multiple scratches were found in the metal of the coupling sections of Odakyu 7000 type and donor 10000 type cars, and as a result the 1000 series was also temporarily inspected and withdrawn from service.
2011
February 13 - Begins being used for B limited express services due to the timetable revision.
September - Automatic announcements and LED in-car information displays are introduced.
2015
April 18 - Operation of the sightseeing guide train "Yukemuri ~ Nonbiri-gō ~" begins. Except during inspections etc., this type is used exclusively.
章节.その他:
Both the 1st and 2nd formations were modified at the Nippon Sharyō Toyokawa Works, but both formations were originally built by Kawasaki Heavy Industries. Some Odakyu 10000-type formations were also built by Nippon Sharyō, and DeHa 10001, preserved at the Romancecar Museum, is one of them.
In connection with the introduction of this type, Yudanaka Station carried out scale-reduction works in September 2006, including abolishing the on-site switchback and one platform track to become a single-track, single-platform station.
Until the timetable revision of February 13, 2011, this type was not used for limited express trains (B limited express) stopping at every station between Shinshū-Nakano Station and Yudanaka Station. There was also an operation in which cars were exchanged with a 2000 series at Suzaka Station, and in that case, if one transferred to the train specified in the timetable, one could ride with a single limited express ticket.
Even after this type was introduced, the limited express surcharge remained unchanged at 100 yen. However, unlike the 2000 series, all trains on which it is used are limited express services, so since the start of operation a limited express surcharge has been required to ride.
From June 1, 2021, it became possible to reserve the end car (including the observation seats) of A limited express services operating in the daytime as reserved seats from a web page. (Excluding various events, group use, and other times of timetable disruption.)

== Operation ==
At the start of operation it was used exclusively for A limited express services, and the 2000 series continued to be used for B limited express services.
However, from the timetable revision carried out on February 13, 2011 in conjunction with the start of operation of the 2100 series, it was changed to be used for both A and B services. At the same time, its use for ordinary trains between duties was abolished. As a result, this type came to be used, as before, for A limited express services on the entire Nagano Line and also for B limited express services, expanding its operating time bands.
In addition, on the "Nonbiri-gō" operated since 2015 this type is used exclusively, and it is also given priority on special trains such as the "Kitashinano Wine Valley Train" and the "Nagaden BEER TRAIN." Furthermore, when the Yashiro Line was abolished in 2012, it was run on that line for the first time since the vehicle transport.

== History ==
2005
August 12 - Of the four 10000-type formations of Odakyu Electric Railway, two formations are transferred free of charge to Nagano Electric Railway.
December 15 - January 31, 2006 - A competition is held to solicit a car nickname. A total of 2,992 entries were received.
2006
March 17 - The car nickname is decided as "Yukemuri."
November 3 and 4 - Trial rides and an open-house event are held. A trial-ride train was operated between Nagano Station and Yudanaka Station.
December 2 - The "Yukemuri Charter Special Tour" organized by Nagaden Kankō is held.
December 9 - Revenue service begins in conjunction with the timetable revision.
2007
January 10 - February 1 - Because cracks were found in the window glass of the observation-seat part of car No. 1 of the 2nd formation (S2 formation), trains using that formation were operated with car No. 1 closed off and the remaining three cars carrying passengers. Repairs were carried out from January 30 to February 1, and a 2000 series ran as a substitute.
July 9 - 30 - Because cracks were found in the window glass of the observation-seat part of car No. 4 of the 2nd formation (S2 formation), it was withdrawn from service and a 2000 series ran as a substitute.
2010
January 12 - 25 - Multiple scratches were found in the metal of the coupling sections of Odakyu 7000 type and donor 10000 type cars, and as a result the 1000 series was also temporarily inspected and withdrawn from service.
2011
February 13 - Begins being used for B limited express services due to the timetable revision.
September - Automatic announcements and LED in-car information displays are introduced.
2015
April 18 - Operation of the sightseeing guide train "Yukemuri ~ Nonbiri-gō ~" begins. Except during inspections etc., this type is used exclusively.

== Other ==
Both the 1st and 2nd formations were modified at the Nippon Sharyō Toyokawa Works, but both formations were originally built by Kawasaki Heavy Industries. Some Odakyu 10000-type formations were also built by Nippon Sharyō, and DeHa 10001, preserved at the Romancecar Museum, is one of them.
In connection with the introduction of this type, Yudanaka Station carried out scale-reduction works in September 2006, including abolishing the on-site switchback and one platform track to become a single-track, single-platform station.
Until the timetable revision of February 13, 2011, this type was not used for limited express trains (B limited express) stopping at every station between Shinshū-Nakano Station and Yudanaka Station. There was also an operation in which cars were exchanged with a 2000 series at Suzaka Station, and in that case, if one transferred to the train specified in the timetable, one could ride with a single limited express ticket.
Even after this type was introduced, the limited express surcharge remained unchanged at 100 yen. However, unlike the 2000 series, all trains on which it is used are limited express services, so since the start of operation a limited express surcharge has been required to ride.
From June 1, 2021, it became possible to reserve the end car (including the observation seats) of A limited express services operating in the daytime as reserved seats from a web page. (Excluding various events, group use, and other times of timetable disruption.)
